blocks.title: 第 1 篇
blocks.text:
【沪教】八上英语·必背范文
Unit1Lookitup
Mark Twain was an American writer. He wrote many famous novels.He was born in the countryside
in Florida in 1835. When he was 12, his father died. He began working and did many different jobs.
Gradually, he began to write. The Adventures of Tom Sawyer is one of his most famous novels. Many
peoplearound theworld likehisworks.
From Mark Twain, I learn that our experience in the past will bring something new to us in the
future. It isimportant for us toseizethe timeand beabetter person.
Dear John,
It's great to hear from you. Ifeel proud to knowthat you are interested in Chinesehistory.
As for my favourite figure in Chinese history, it must be Wei Yuan, a great thinker in the late Qing
Dynasty. His major contribution was his book called Haiguo Tuzhi. In the book, he introduced the history
and political system of many countries, and advised Chinese people to study the science and technology
of the Western countries. I admire this man a lot because he used his knowledge to promote the progress
ofthe societyat that time.He also inspired me tobe open to newideas.
If you want toknowmoreabout him, Iwill recommend somebooks to you!
Yours,
Li Ming

blocks.title: 第 2 篇
blocks.text:
【沪教】八上英语·必背范文
Unit2Amazing numbers
Last week,our school did a survey among 2,000 students about how they spent their time during the
summerholiday.The resultsare as follows.
According to the survey, 45% of the students studied during the holiday. They read books or did
their homework. Besides, 30% of the students played phones. For example, some of them played online
games and some surfed the Internet. And 20% of the students went travelling with their friends or
families. Last,therest 100students did somevoluntary work inthecommunity.
In my opinion,we should havea meaningful holiday. Don't spend too much timeplaying online
games. Weshould makegood use oftheholidays.
Last week, Miss Lin made asurvey ondoing housework inour class. According to thesurvey, 40
per cent of ourclassmates often dosomewashing, such as washing clothes, thedishes and vegetables. 35
per cent of studentsclean thehouse. They sweep thefloorand clean thewindows. 12per cent of students
dosomeshopping fortheir families. And 8per cent ofthem dothecooking. However, 5per cent of
students hardly doany housework.
Ithink as amember ofthe family, it's ourresponsibility todohousework. Weshould learn to do
somesimplehousework. It's also helpful for usto learn somelifeskills from it.

blocks.title: 第 3 篇
blocks.text:
【沪教】八上英语·必背范文
Unit3Ourdigitallives
Computers are moreand moreuseful inour lives.
I think that they help us with our studies a lot. Firstly, we can look for some information about our
studies on the Internet. What's more, we can watch different movies on the Internet. It's very convenient.
However, some students spend too much time playing computer games or chatting online. It is not only
harmful totheir health, but italso affects theirstudy. Theirparents are worried about them.
In my opinion,we shouldn't play computer games onweekdays, but we can surf theInternet fora
whileat weekends and during holidays. In a word, we shouldn't spend too much timeplaying computer
games.
Shoppingonline has been popular with many peoplebecause it has many advantages. First, shopping
online is fast and convenient, so we can save alot of time. Second, we can buy cheaper products. Besides,
wecan shopwhenever welikebecause most onlineshops are open 24hours aday.
However, it has some disadvantages too. For example, we can't check the goods by ourselves before
we buy it, so we don't know whether the quality of the goods is good or bad. What's worse, it is not
always safeto pay online.
In my opinion, we should learn how to keep safe while shopping online, and we must think twice
before we decide to buysomething.

blocks.title: 第 4 篇
blocks.text:
【沪教】八上英语·必背范文
Unit4Inventions
Technological inventions play an important role in our daily lives. Among all the technological
inventions,I likethehigh-speed train best.
The high-speed train has many advantages. First, it can save us lots of time. For example, it takes us
only about 30 minutes to travel from Guangzhou to Shenzhen. Moreover, it's comfortable to take the
high-speed train because it moves sosmoothlythat passengers can watch movies orhave asleep onit.
As a student, I'm proud of our country's high-speed train. And I will study harder and make
contributions to oursociety in thefuture.
Dear Michael,
I'm glad to receive your letter and get a chance to discuss artificial intelligence with you. I don't
think you needto betooworried about it. AIbrings great convenience to ourlife.
First of all, AI can be used to do dangerous jobs and keep workers safe. If people don't want to
repeat the same boring and tiring work day after day, they can use AI to help them as well. Therefore,
people can spend their free time on what they are interested in. What's more, AI can also help farmers in
growing crops. For example, itcan accurately tellfarmers howmuch water crops need.
However, I don't think AI can take the place of human beings because they can't produce new ideas.
In my opinion, you shouldlearn more about howto useAI properly instead ofworrying about itsnegative
effects. I'm lookingforward toyour reply.
Yours,
Li Hua

blocks.title: 第 5 篇
blocks.text:
【沪教】八上英语·必背范文
Unit5Going onan exchangetrip
Dear Manda,
I'm writing to thank you and your family for everything you did for me when I lived with you in
Britain.
You and your family were amazing hosts, and you made me have a great time in the UK. Thank you
for making me feel at home. Besides, I'm sure my English has improved a lot because you always give
me a helping hand. What's more, because of living with you, I have learnt a lot about the culture of the
UK. And it was nice of you to take me to the places of interest during the holidays. Now I know more
about London and feel it is my second hometown.
I hope we can keep in touch with each other forever. If you have time, please come to China and I
can showyou around mycity as well.
Yours,
Li Hua
I want to sincerely thank you for your help with my studies. Your support has not only improved my
grades but also taught mevaluable lessons.
When I met with difficult math problems, I saw how patiently you explained each step to me. Your
patience taught me the importance of staying calm. Before the English oral test, I was very nervous, but
you encouraged me and practiced with me until I felt confident. Your positive attitude showed me the
power ofencouragement.
Through your actions, I learned to be more patient and supportive towards others. I feel deeply
grateful and truly cherish ourfriendship. Youare not justa helper butalso a rolemodel tome.

blocks.title: 第 6 篇
blocks.text:
【沪教】八上英语·必背范文
Unit6Wisdomcounts
The story of"Borrowing Arrows with Straw Boats" shows howsmart Zhuge Liang was. He needed
many arrows for abattle, but hedidn't have enough timeto makethem.
So, he had aclever idea. He ordered his soldiers to put manystraw menon boats.Onefoggy morning,
hemoved theboats near theenemy camp. The enemy could not see clearly becauseofthe thick fog. They
thought thestrawmen were real soldiers and started shootingarrows at them. Soon, thestraw men were
full ofarrows. Zhuge Liang then sailed back with all thearrows heneeded.
From thisstory, Ilearn that being smart is better than being just strong. Weshoulduse ourwisdom
to solvedifficult problems.
This story about Cao Chong shows howachild can bevery wise. One day, someone gavehis father,
Cao Cao, ahuge elephant. Everyone wondered, "Howcan we weigh thisgiant animal?" No scale was big
enough.
Young Cao Chong came upwitha brilliant idea. He had theelephant led onto abig boat in theriver.
Hemarked thewater level ontheboat's side. Then, hetook theelephant off and filled theboat with stones
untilit sank to thesame mark. Theweight ofthestones was equal to theweight ofthe elephant. People
could thenweigh the stones easily.
From Cao Chong,I learn to thinkcreatively. Whenfaced with a bigproblem, we should look fora
simpleand smart solution.

blocks.title: 第 7 篇
blocks.text:
【沪教】八上英语·必背范文
Unit7Thesecret ofmemory
Dear Jack,
I'm glad togive you someadvice onhow toimproveyour memory.
First of all, in order to train your brain, it's a good idea to do some new things and change your daily
habits. In this way, you can make your brain more active and creative. Besides, living a healthy lifestyle
also makes sense. It requires a balanced diet and enough time for your brain to relax after a busy day.
What's more, I advise you not to be too nervous and keep relaxed, or you can't focus on your study the
next day. Last but not least, if you have any trouble, please talk to your friends and teachers anytime you
need.
Ihope my advicecan help you. I am lookingforward to your improvement.
Best wishes!
Yours,
Li Hua
Hello, everyone! I think memory is very important in our lives. Here are some practical ways to
improveourmemory.
First, we need to exercise our brain more often to keep it active. For example, we can try learning a
new language or playing anew musical instrument. Besides, to better memorize something ina short time,
wehad better remember it again and again. In addition,if wewant ourbrain to work well, living ahealthy
life is worth a try. We should have a balanced diet and get enough sleep. They are good for our brain.
Last but not least, we need tostay relaxed so that we can memorizethings morequickly.
That's all. Thank you!

blocks.title: 第 8 篇
blocks.text:

Unit8Pets and us
I think dogs are the perfect pets. They are very loyal and always happy to see you. A dog is like a
best friend who will never leave your side.
First of all, dogs are also great companions. They love to play and go for walks, which helps you
stay active. Beside, they are also very comforting when you feel sad. Last but not least, dogs give us
unconditional love. They don't care about anything but being with you.
For all thesereasons, I believea dogistheperfect pet you can have.
Many people likedogs or cats, but Ithink birds make theperfect pets.
First, they are very beautiful with colorful feathers. It is nice to watch them. Second, birds are easy
to look afterso wedon’t have to pay muchattention onthem. What’smore, they liveinacage, so they
don't needa big space. Thisis perfect forpeople livingin apartments.
For all thesereasons, I believea bird isthe perfect pet you can have.
